name: XWC Mayhem '97
notes: The fed's own pay-per-view: a four-way tag title match re-sanctioned mid-match by the ring announcer (the European Technicians retain), a live on-camera invasion by a rival federation's wrestler ejected by an in-fiction police officer, and a main-event ladder-cage unification match in which the International Champion beats the World Champion for both belts and is announced Heavyweight Champion of the World.
